MIND. [1] [Chel.]
Vanishing of senses.
Loses her head when she gets out of bed, could not explain why. θ Influenza.
Forgets what she wants to do or has done ; great absence of mind.
Sudden excitement with confusion of intellect at night. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Difficult thinking.
Imagines she cannot think and will lose her reason.
Thinks she must die.
Delirium. θ Influenza. θ Pneumonia.
Quiet delirium, mostly at night, followed by lethargy which continues through the day.
Talked incoherently during the fit of anxiety. θ Erysipelas.
Stupefaction. θ Valvular disease of heart.
Whimpering, with headache on left side.
Weeping and despondency.
Distaste for mental exertion and conversation. θ Dyspepsia. θ Indigestion.
Sadness and depression of spirits. θ Hepatic troubles.
Anxiety. θ Chorea. θ Influenza. θ Erysipelas.
Restlessness and uneasiness of conscience ; feels that she has committed the unpardonable sin, and that she will be eternally lost.
Anxiety : allowing no rest at any employment ; as if she had committed a crime ; fear of getting crazy, with restlessness and heat.
Anxiety, with a sense of constriction in larynx. θ Œdema of lungs.
(In sick :) Dreadful anxiety and uneasiness. θ Influenza.
Sudden anxiety, with strong palpitation.
Sudden excitement and confusion of intellect. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Irritability and ill humor.
Fretful mood, with inclination to weep.
Is vexed about every trifle and has violent attacks of passionate outbursts of temper.
Quarrelsomeness.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Chel.]
Giddiness in morning and headache on awaking. θ Indigestion.
Vertigo : with bilious vomiting and pain in liver ; with confusion of head ; with stumbling, as if to fall forward ; with mental disturbance ; on closing eyes, as if everything was turning in a circle ; on sitting up in bed ; with shivering over upper part of body ; on attempting to rise in morning, keeping her in bed. θ Influenza. θ Valvular disease. θ Dyspepsia. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Chorea.
Confusion in head. θ Valvular disease.
Loss of consciousness. θ Kidney disease.
Fainting. θ Valvular disease.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Chel.]
Shooting in forehead under skin.
Shooting in frontal bone over left eye ; later on left side of occiput.
Hammering, burning, stitching, or tearing pains. θ Supraorbital neuralgia.
Tensive pain in forehead, as from a band above eyes. θ Acute rheumatism.
Outward pressing pain in forehead.
Pressive pain in right side of forehead.
Violent pains in forehead above eyes. θ Influenza.
Pressure in forehead, extending to orbits, which pain as if sore on moving eyes.
Pain extending to forehead and all over head ; beginning at 2 or 3 P. M., at its height at 8 or 9 P. M., preventing all sleep or even lying down till nearly daybreak. θ Acute inflammation of eyes.
Violent neuralgia over right eye, extending into eye and cheek. θ Prosopalgia.
Dull frontal headache.
Continuous sharp frontal headache. θ Hepatic typhus.
Sensation of heat in forehead.
Tearing pain in right temple, < by motion.
Neuralgic pains in temples, forehead, ears, teeth, eyes and eyebrows.
Tensive pains in temples.
Neuralgia of temple and eyebrow, particularly of right side.
Pressive pain in right temple, right parietal bone and finally over right eye.
Throbbing in temples.
Ticking like a watch in right temple.
Violent pain in left side of head and face.
Periodical shooting pain in left parietal bone.
Sensation of heat in left side of head, proceeding from ear.
Stitching pains in vertex, < when walking rapidly.
Periodical stitching, pressing pain in vertex.
Pressing on vertex.
Pinching stitching in right side of occiput.
Painful throbbing and drawing in occiput.
Tensive sensation in back of head on right side.
Pain in occiput and nape of neck. θ Hemorrhoids.
Great heaviness in occiput, with drawing in neck from above downward.
Occiput feels heavy, as if it could not be raised from pillow, at night.
Heaviness in occiput with pressing to left ear. θ Hepatitis.
Coldness in occiput, rising up from nape of neck, < when moving ; > during rest.
Drawing, pressing-like stitches, extending from left side of occiput to forehead.
Violent drawing from crown to nape ; she is forced to draw up her shoulders, close her eyes and tread lightly.
Violent pain in left side of head and face, as if cut off at septum and middle of forehead. θ Prosopalgia.
Pressive headache, with frequently recurring heat of face. θ Liver complaint.
Pressure and transient pains under bones of head, even in brain ; headache > after eating.
Pulsating headache.
Pain in head with sparks before eyes. θ Kidney disease.
Pressure in brain, with burning over eyebrows.
Cranium feels too small.
Headache in morning on waking. θ Dyspepsia.
Headache < in open air, when coughing, blowing nose and stooping.
Megrim with lethargy. θ Bright's disease.
Heaviness like a weight in different parts of head ; on vertex, extending to occipital protuberance, heavy pressure inwardly ; weight in forehead as if it was falling outward ; occiput seems as if fastened to pillow and broken off from rest of skull ; must raise head with hand when sitting up. θ Liver complaint.
Congestion to cerebellum. θ Chorea.
Congestion of blood to head ; throbbing in temples with great anxiety ; repeated attacks of violent throbbing pains from nape to occiput.
Dull pain in head.
Pressure in occiput.
Heat of head. θ Erysipelas.
Heat and confusion of head, with great thirst. θ Laryngitis.
Twitching here and there in head.
Sick headache every fortnight, with pain in right hypochondrium, pain < in right forehead and temple ; nausea and bilious vomiting.
Vertex feels as if bruised on being touched.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Chel.]
Trembling of head.
(In sick :) Feeling as if head was drawn forcibly backward. θ Influenza.
Drawing in nape and occiput. θ Influenza.
Scalp very sore at slightest touch. θ Erysipelas.
Head heavy as lead ; during exacerbation of pain head drawn to left side. θ Prosopalgia.
Scalp on crown painful, hot when touched ; pain as if in roots of hairs when combed, as if from ulceration.
Sensation as if hair stood on end.
Falling out of hair.
Superficial ulcer on mastoid process subsequent to neuralgia in left side of head and face ; ulceration extends downward to shoulder and breast and across to right shoulder, has a lardaceous appearance, bleeds readily and discharges thin fetid pus.
Severe itching on occiput.
Facial erysipelas spreading over hairy scalp ; very sore to slightest touch.
Scald head.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Chel.]
Photophobia. θ Influenza. θ Ophthalmia. θ Hordeolum. θ Measles.
Photophobia, with pain in forehead and eyes.
Flickering before eyes ; brilliant specks.
(In sick :) Candlelight seems very small.
Sparks before eyes. θ Valvular heart disease. θ Nephritis.
Dazzling spot before eyes, lachrymation when looking at it. θ Cataract.
Blackness before eyes, with a sensation of fainting. θ Influenza.
Misty appearance before eyes. θ Cataract.
Amaurosis from rheumatic troubles, also after suppression of ringworm.
Objects appear double. θ Opacity of lens.
When reading or writing, letters run together and seem blurred ; blackish-grey specks before eyes.
Weak sight, cannot distinguish letters. θ Opacity of lens.
Looking intently makes eyes water and produces a stupid feeling.
Eyes inflamed and very sensitive to light, sees very indistinctly. θ Prosopalgia.
Muscæ volitantes.
Amblyopia with vomiting and coma. θ Retinitis apoplectica.
Eyes dull, dilated pupils. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Pupils contracted, or contractility diminished.
Sensation of burning in eyes, as of a foreign body. θ Acute inflammation of eye.
Feeling of sand in eyes ; tears flow constantly over cheeks. θ Prosopalgia. θ Measles.
Pain in eyes as if pierced with knives. θ Prosopalgia.
Shooting pains in eyes, first left then right ; pressure in upper part of eyeballs as if they were squeezed, left worse.
Burning and shooting in eyes. θ Hordeolum.
Pulsating, burning, lancinating pains in eyes.
Repeated tearing in left eye.
Tearing pain in left eye, extending to zygoma, teeth, forehead and temple ; first > by pressure, but soon cannot endure slightest touch ; periodic, evening in bed. θ Prosopalgia.
Tearing, pressing and stitching in right and afterwards in l. eye.
(In sick :) A momentary biting sting in right eye, changing its place.
Neuralgic pain in and above eyes, with lachrymation.
Right supraorbital neuralgia.
Aching in eyeballs on looking up or moving the eyes.
Bruised pain in right eye, from front to back, > by pressure, < from light, air and holding down head. θ Neuralgia.
Pressing in eyes.
Pressure in eyeball. θ Hepatitis.
Severe pressive pain in left eyeball, in middle of ball, which seems to be so large that the upper lid would not cover it.
Sensation of heat in left eye.
Feeling of sand in eyes.
Lamplight aggravates pains of eyes.
Tearing pain in and above eyes ; stitches above left.
Pressure in orbits.
Pain in orbits as if bruised on moving eyes.
Stupefying pressure on right orbit from without in.
Raging pain above edge of right brow, drawing through eye to cheek and jaw.
Violent pain above eyes. θ Influenza.
Stitches above left eye.
Pressing pain over left eye, which seems to press down upper lid.
Pulsating pain in right eyebrow and temple on waking, preceded by shivering ; the pain slight at first increases almost to distraction.
Squinting ; loss of power of right external rectus, eye turned inward.
Distortion of eyes. θ Pneumonia.
Eyes distorted with twitching of corners of mouth and diarrhœa. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Eye inflamed, sensitive to light, sight indistinct.
Conjunctiva swollen, dark red, as far as cornea. θ Hordeolum. θ Whooping cough.
Whites of eyes of a deep or dirty yellow.
Opacity of lens on right side, with a small speck on cornea.
Opacity of cornea.
Lens uniformly grey.
Staphylomatous swelling of cornea ; water gushes from eye on looking up.
Eye red, burning, protuberant, and watery. θ Neuralgia.
Lachrymation. θ Influenza.
Lachrymation, with pains of eyes ; from tickling in larynx.
On opening eyes, tears flow over cheek. θ Fistula lachrymalis.
Increased secretion of Meibomian glands.
Could not open her eyes at all. θ Prosopalgia.
Inclination and necessity to close lids, which > the pain, without photophobia.
Sticking pain on the inside of lower left lid.
Burning in lids.
Pressure in upper lids ; sometimes painful.
Twitching of lids.
Heaviness of lids.
Weight, burning and pressive swelling of lids.
Eyelids sore and swollen, conjunctivæ much inflamed. θ Prosopalgia.
Lids swollen, red, could open them but little. θ Hordeolum.
Inflammation and nightly agglutination ; the lower tarsal edges are red and swollen ; dimness of eyes in morning.
Left eye sunken, lids separated with difficulty when tears flowed over cheek. θ Prosopalgia.
Catarrhal inflammation of lids with sympathetic irritation of Meibomian glands.
Redness and swelling of margins of lids.
Right eyelids inflamed and scabby, cannot open them. θ Influenza.
Lower lids bordered by dark blue rings. θ Intestinal catarrh.
Itching sticking in left inner canthus.
Thick, yellow mucous discharge from eyes. θ Hordeolum.
Agglutination of lids in morning. θ Acute inflammation.
Eyelashes almost all gone on right lower lid. θ Hordeolum.
Fistula lachrymalis.
